/material/rope.name: Load, twist and counter-lay hemp rope
steps: Combine four bundles of the same yarn material into one held stack before loading an empty anchored hand ropewalk. Apply matching yarn stacks to each other to combine them. Materials cannot be mixed.
Use for 100 ticks to twist four strands under tension, then use again for 100 ticks to lay them together in the opposite direction.
Four yarn bundles represent equal-length groups of yarn, not four individual threads. Four output coils are game units.
Recover paid unfinished work by dragging the frame onto yourself. A twisted batch resumes at counter-laying.
Output is ordinary rope for existing consumers. Grass crude twine, sinew, tow twine and direct raw-plant recipes remain available.

/material/wood.name: Grow a timber tree
steps: Forage small bushes with a kitchen knife on Help intent for a chance of tree seeds, or obtain a map-placed tree-seed crate.
Stand beside an empty outdoor ploughed plot under open sky and use one tree-seed portion on it.
Water and feed the seedling through six successful minute-long growth stages. Clear obstructions and wait for a suitable climate and season.

The seedling becomes an ordinary seasonal tree. Chop the mature tree for seven logs. Uprooting a living or dead seedling requires a shovel or spade (unfold folding tools first) and returns no logs or seeds; knives and hatchets cannot uproot it.
/material/wood.conditions: One seed portion per successful planting. Outdoor ploughed space must stay clear of roofs, dense objects, living occupants and other crops. Drought and storms can kill seedlings; poor soil may delay growth. Winter pauses development but not water use. Growth progress survives saves; downtime adds no growth.
/material/wood.map_notes: Seed foraging is random and map-placed crates are not guaranteed. Tree growth requires both a declared biome and season on every map. Existing tree biomes are inherited; seasons are SUMMER, SPRING, FALL, Wet Season and Dry Season.
/material/wood.era: No additional era restriction established by this procedure.
/material/wood.status: source-reviewed proposed shovel-only update; changed uprooting native acceptance pending

/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.name: Grow and harvest turnip
steps: Sow one seed in a prepared ploughed plot.
Keep the crop alive until harvest-ready, then harvest with a suitable sharp tool.
Keep spores/seeds for another planting; eat the produce or store it off the floor.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.conditions: temperate, sea, tundra or taiga outdoor/open-sky ploughed soil; all four ordinary seasons including winter. Each harvest retires the crop and returns two seeds/spores plus one to three food items depending on fertility; each food has two nutriment. Snowstorm protection does not remove water/soil costs, drought or sandstorm death. Normal stage progression.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.map_notes: Rock must be cleared then suitable dirt ploughed. Jungle dirt and Desert-map dust remain unsuitable.
/obj/item/stack/farming/seeds/turnip.era: Plough: four wood planks, Basic Agriculture research rules (node tier 1); no new era gate for seed or food.

/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.name: Grind logs into chip batches
steps: Anchor the powered grinder, insert at least five whole raw logs and start it.
After the existing ten-plus-five-second cycle, collect one chip batch per five logs. Unpaid remainders stay installed.
Hold the chips and apply them to an adjacent oven-family structure to refuel it.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.conditions: Five logs produce one abstract batch containing five log units of feedstock, not a physical yield measurement. Ten batches per stack. Power/ownership/input checks must succeed at completion; observed power loss or cancellation gives no output. Chips cannot replace logs in crafting or convert back to logs.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.map_notes: Wizard Boy retains its mapped base grinder in maps/special/wizard_boy.dmm and its camp catalog. The global catalog can build a constructed wood grinder under Electricity; no recipe in camp, Carib or species overrides and no map-level resource reachability guarantee.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.era: Mapped base grinder: no added machine research gate. Constructed variant: Electricity node (era tier 5), maximum recipe era 8; existing baseline grants apply.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline transaction checks passed; native gameplay and save/load unverified

/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.name: Fuel an oven with chip batches
steps: Hold a chip stack in hand and use it on an adjacent oven, campfire or wood stove.
Each paid batch supplies five existing oven fuel units and five paid-wood residue units, equal to its five input logs.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.conditions: Consumes held whole batches once before assigning fuel or residue credit. Loading creates no ash; the existing paid-fuel burn ledger governs residue. No other fuel family or pulp recipe added.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.map_notes: Requires an accessible existing oven-family structure and chip stock; no map-level reachability guarantee.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.era: No new fuel-specific era/research gate; station availability remains separate.
/obj/item/stack/wood_chips.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline raw-log parity checks passed; native burn and save/load unverified

/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.name: Use a constructed wood grinder
steps: Build the wood grinder from a required 20 electronics; ordinary debit is 20 and Production debit is 18.
Anchor the initially empty, off machine, connect paid cable supply and insert at least five raw logs.
To relocate, remove cables and unfasten it; constructed machines cannot be dismantled for materials.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.conditions: Existing global catalog only; Electricity completed or supplied by baseline-era rules. Base 120-ds construction time is scaled by strength and crafting. No new grinder skill gate. Circuit crafting requires coefficient >= 2.2 plus copper and iron; input costs are nominal because bulk discounts apply. All grinder transaction and chip/fuel behavior is inherited unchanged.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.map_notes: Wizard Boy mapped base grinder and camp catalog unchanged; no new Carib, camp or species recipe. Existing steam engine plus two lit heatsources is a source-backed 30-capacity option, not a native or full-map guarantee.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.era: Electricity node era tier 5, minimum bench tier 4, Steam Power prerequisite and cable prototype; maximum recipe era 8. No new calendar-year/minimum-era gate.
/obj/structure/grinder/constructed.status: Source-reviewed candidate; offline acquisition checks passed; native construction, inventory, power network and save/load unverified

recipes.name: Load, twist and counter-lay flax rope
recipes.conditions: Combine four bundles of the same yarn material into one held stack before loading an empty anchored hand ropewalk. Apply matching yarn stacks to each other to combine them. Materials cannot be mixed. Use for 100 ticks to twist four strands under tension, then use again for 100 ticks to lay them together in the opposite direction. Four yarn bundles represent equal-length groups of yarn, not four individual threads. Four output coils are game units. Recover paid unfinished work by dragging the frame onto yourself. A twisted batch resumes at counter-laying. Output is ordinary rope for existing consumers. Grass crude twine, sinew, tow twine and direct raw-plant recipes remain available.
